learnings: Models frequently misinterpret top-level network calls in PKGBUILDs as malicious telemetry or supply-chain attacks, even when they are standard patterns for resolving dynamic source URLs or submodule commits. Models should be forced to review all maintainer files in the repository, not just the PKGBUILD, to ensure complete coverage and avoid missing context.
